alleged_contradiction: Text claimed chip 'falls within a single geographic geohash-5 cell' while simultaneously claiming 4 quadrant geohash-5 cells (6z2zz, 6z3pb, 6z8bp, 6z900).
investigation: The AOI centroid sits exactly on the 4-way corner vertex (-2.8125, -54.84375). The chip does NOT fall within a single cell; it straddles all 4 adjacent cells, with 64 pixels in each. The single-cell claim in prose was factually incorrect and removed.
